gate_reasoning: Stage 4 scores 62% Low / 30% Medium / 8% High across 50 scored claims. The Low concentration is driven by three structural factors that are partially inherent to this research domain and partially remediable: (1) Vendor-marketing-override is the dominant trigger (27 claims), reflecting that Stage 4's subject matter is almost entirely composed of private companies (project44, FourKites, Shippeo, Tive, Controlant, Overhaul, Portcast) who self-report their own operational metrics with no audited equivalents — this cannot be fully remediated for private companies, but Form D SEC filings should be retrieved for all funding rounds; (2) The most commercially critical data point for PP 4.3 (Beacon's 13.9% ocean ETA on-time rate in 2025) is auto-low-vendor because Beacon is a visibility platform vendor analyzing their own platform data — an independent source (Sea-Intelligence, Xeneta, or Drewry) for 2025 schedule reliability would elevate this to Medium or High; (3) Berg Insight cargo tracking 13th Edition (the market's best available primary source for cargo IoT metrics) remains NEEDS-ATTENDED-FETCH for the 2025 figures — if fetched and confirmed, the three Berg Insight cargo tracking market size claims would upgrade from Medium to High and the overall High% would improve materially. One factual accuracy flag requires correction: FourKites is misidentified as a 2025 Gartner MQ Leader in the value chain section when they withdrew from the 2025 MQ. Deep research should target: (a) independent ocean freight ETA/schedule-reliability data from Sea-Intelligence or Xeneta; (b) IQVIA 2024 update to the $35B pharma cold chain loss figure; (c) Berg Insight 13th Edition attended fetch; (d) Form D filings for all private company funding rounds; (e) Carrier Global 10-K attend-fetch for Sensitech financial context. The structural claim arguments (visibility collapse at subcontract handoff, sensor data siloing, SEA market gap) are analytically sound but are evidenced almost entirely by vendor-produced materials — the conceptual framework is strong, the evidentiary sourcing is weak.

notes_on_stage_4_specific_issues.no_primary_gov_sources: Stage 4 has zero government statistics agency sources and zero multilateral agency sources, reflecting the absence of government data on RTTVP and cargo IoT markets. This is a genuine data availability constraint, not a research failure. The Berg Insight specialist research fills the data role that government statistics fill in other sectors.
notes_on_stage_4_specific_issues.private_company_dominance: All major Stage 4 vendors (project44, FourKites, Shippeo, Tive, Overhaul, Portcast, Controlant) are private companies with no publicly audited financial disclosures. The vendor-marketing-override must apply to all their self-reported metrics. The only audited financial anchor in Stage 4 is Carrier Global (NYSE: CARR) for Sensitech, and that 10-K is NEEDS-ATTENDED-FETCH.
